attacks.name: Headbutt
steps: After this attack is resolved, this character gains |!power| equal to the |!damage| dealt.
|!wild| |*Push|: Before |!damage| is dealt, if the defender is |!size| 3 or less, this character may Push it Away |!range_small|.
|!wild| |*Stun|: After this attack is resolved, the defender gains the |§stun§Stun| special condition.

attacks.name: Cane Laser
steps: This attack ignores LOS, and the defender does not benefit from Cover.

attacks.name: Hail to the King
steps: Before |!damage| is dealt, if the defender is |!size| 3 or less, this character may Throw it |!range_small|.
After this attack is resolved, the defender gains the |§stagger§Stagger| special condition.

superPowers.name: Illicit Network (Affiliation: Criminal Syndicate)
superPowers.body: Once per turn, at any time during an allied character’s Activation, it may spend 2 |!power| to use this Leadership Ability. Move one Asset or Civilian token being held by the active character to another allied character within |!range| 3. A character cannot hold more tokens than allowed by the Crisis due to this Leadership Ability.|\|Additionally, each Healthy non-Grunt allied character Contesting a Secure objective token counts as 2 Healthy characters when determining who is Securing the objective token.

superPowers.name: Street-Level Negotiations
superPowers.body: Choose an interactive terrain feature or an enemy character, both of |!size| 3 or less and within |!range| 2, and Throw it |!range_medium|. This superpower can be used only once per Turn.

superPowers.name: Intense Physical Conditioning
superPowers.body: If this character would suffer |!damage|, it may use this superpower. Reduce the amount of |!damage| suffered by 1.

superPowers.name: Solid Frame
superPowers.body: This character does not suffer |!damage| from collisions with other characters.

erratas.body: Illicit Network now only counts a character as 2 Healthy characters when Contesting a Secure objective token instead of any type of objective token".
Illicit Network rule was changed from "each allied Healthy character contesting" to "each Healthy non-Grunt allied character contesting".
Hail to the King's throw is now limited to Size 3 or less instead of unlimited.
